title: Text normalisation, tokenisation, stemming and lemmatisation
description: Turn raw strings into clean tokens; stems versus lemmas; what is lost at each step.

title: Bag of words, n-grams and TF-IDF
description: Sparse count vectors, inverse document frequency weighting, L2 normalisation and cosine similarity.

title: Text classification with Naive Bayes and logistic regression
description: Multinomial Naive Bayes with smoothing, linear models on TF-IDF, precision/recall/F1 on text, error analysis and class imbalance.

title: Sequence labelling: HMMs and the Viterbi algorithm
description: POS tagging and BIO named-entity tagging with a hidden Markov model, exact decoding by dynamic programming, and the CRF idea.

title: N-gram language models, smoothing and perplexity
description: Count-based next-word models, add-k, interpolation and backoff, and perplexity as exponentiated cross-entropy.

title: Topic modelling with LDA
description: The LDA generative story, Dirichlet priors, collapsed Gibbs sampling, topic evaluation and embedding-based topics.

title: Translation, summarisation and QA evaluation
description: BLEU, ROUGE, extractive span prediction and the pitfalls of overlap metrics.
